Mrs. Fisher: You already caught more than a dozen carps. Good job.
Mrs. Fisher: Is your bathtub big enough to fit them all?
You: Uh…{{wi}} What are you talking about?
Mrs. Fisher: W-Well, there’s that eastern European tradition in which-
Mrs. Fisher: Forget it…
You: No, please tell me about it.
Mrs. Fisher: Carp is a traditional christmas dish in eastern europe. In the past they didn’t have refrigerators so they kept the fish in bathtubs to make sure they wouldn't spoil.
Mrs. Fisher: Some say it also improved the taste of the fish since it would purge the muddiness out of them.
You: Unfortunately, I don’t have a bathtub so I will skip on that technique.
Mrs. Fisher: Sure.
